Name: Aphrodite Ourania
Description: The goddess Aphodite is a member of the Olympian Gods and the goddess of Love and Beauty. In the 1950s, she was bored and went to Earth and disguised as a mortal woman, working in the Beauty Magazine and have a romantic relationship with publisher Whitney Hammond. But she later return to Olympos.
